prompts.sheet: Create ONE four-pose 2x2 animation sprite sheet of exactly the same Polly parrot in attached identity reference. Transparent background. Every cell same size, ample empty padding, whole bird fully visible. Reference is identity model: turquoise head/body/tail, coral wings, cream belly, yellow feet, yellow beak, yellow safari hat with orange band, navy binoculars with blue glass. Preserve same 3/4 view facing viewer-right, same big oval eyes, head/body proportions. Four sequential singing wing gestures: TOP LEFT pose0 open beak singing, both wings lowered at sides; TOP RIGHT pose1 open beak, bird's right wing (viewer left) raised outward; BOTTOM LEFT pose2 closed beak smile, both wings raised outward; BOTTOM RIGHT pose3 open beak singing, bird's left wing (viewer right) raised outward. Feet planted at EXACT same x/y in each cell, hat and head same x/y, body same size, no head bob or leg movement. Wings stay below top of hat and inside each cell. Draw each pose distinctly, maintain anatomy and single clean mouth. No background, no ground shadow, no text, no grid lines, no extra birds. STRICT flat solid color fills, thin clean BLACK outline, NO gradients texture glow or noisy edges. All body areas opaque, only exterior background transparent. High resolution four pose sheet for medium framing animation; same identity and colors as reference.
